kind: run pack (E2: guard on/off non-inferiority, official TRL path, 5 seeds x 2 arms)
purpose: Pre-registered non-inferiority: 30 official GRPO steps per run, guard on vs off x 5 seeds; primary metric = frozen 16-prompt held-out accuracy (disjoint from the 8 training prompts), margin |delta| <= 1/16 question; secondary = in-train reward mean, step time.
hardware: autodl2, 2x RTX 6000D 84GB (trainer GPU0, vLLM server GPU1, mem_util 0.2)
config: GRPOConfig(max_steps=30, per_device_train_batch_size=1, num_generations=4, max_completion_length=32, beta=0, gradient_checkpointing, use_vllm server)

results.heldout_accuracy: on 0.2500 ± 0.0625 vs off 0.2875 ± 0.1135 (5 seeds each, 16 prompts) — delta -0.0375, WITHIN the pre-registered margin (<=1/16 = 0.0625); guard-on variance is smaller
results.honest_reading: 16-prompt resolution is coarse (0.0625 per question); 5 seeds give SD 0.06-0.11. Conclusion: NO held-out degradation beyond one question observed with the guard on; no statistical-equivalence claim (pre-registered margin test only). In-train reward is noise at this scale.

honest_notes: beta=0 (no KL/ref model) — E2 tests whether the guard degrades training, not training quality
held-out accuracy ~0.25 both arms and vs base (P1-2): no capability claim — the guard's non-inferiority holds, generalization does not
evaluation runs in a separate process loading the saved checkpoint (~8GB) — in-process eval after checkpoint save was repeatedly killed by GPU contention on the shared box
some seeds' runs were retried 1-2x due to agent-ttrl GPU contention (shared autodl2); every reported run completed 30 steps and a full 16-prompt eval
